issues.description: The ray_sphere_intersect function has inconsistent return types between artifacts: the template header declares the function as returning bool, the solution header declares it as returning int, while both template and solution implementations (ray_sphere_intersect.cpp) return a bool. This mismatch between header prototypes and implementation will cause confusion and likely compiler warnings/errors (or undefined behavior when linked) and makes it unclear which API students should implement/use.
issues.suggested_fix:
Unify the function prototype and implementation. Change the solution header declaration to return bool (to match the implementation and the template header):

In solution_repository/example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.h, replace 'int ray_sphere_intersect(...)' with 'bool ray_sphere_intersect(...)'.

Alternatively, if an integer return was intended, update both implementations and the template header to use int consistently. Prefer bool here since the implementation returns true/false and the template uses bool.
